name: harbor-eats-app
description: Harbor Eats consumer product — Cloudflare Pages + Workers + D1

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply harbor-eats-db --local --config wrangler.worker.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply harbor-eats-db --remote --config wrangler.worker.toml
scripts.pages:deploy: node -e "console.error('pages:deploy is retired: use npm run deploy:preview or deploy:production');process.exit(2)"
scripts.lint: eslint src public/app.js public/theme.js public/meal-media.js public/taste-ui.js public/planning-ui.js public/discovery-ui.js public/discovery-relax-bridge.js public/nav-context.js functions --max-warnings=0
scripts.test: npm run preflight && npm run test:migrations && npm run test:unit && npm run lint
scripts.ci: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run preflight:preview && node scripts/deploy/deploy.mjs preview
scripts.deploy:production: npm run preflight:production && node scripts/deploy/deploy.mjs production
